description: Source code for the AMRWriter class in Android's media stagefright library, handling AMR audio encoding and file writing.

classes.name: AMRWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing AMR audio data to a file descriptor, managing encoding, threading, and file size/duration limits.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a media source for AMR data, initializes header based on MIME type.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the encoding and writing process, spawns a thread.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Stops the process, joins thread, and resets state.

methods.name: exceedsFileSizeLimit
methods.description: Checks if the file size limit has been exceeded.

methods.name: exceedsFileDurationLimit
methods.description: Checks if the duration limit has been exceeded.

methods.name: threadFunc
methods.description: Main thread loop for reading from source and writing to file, handling limits and errors.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Indicates if end of stream has been reached.
